name: Ship of Harkinian
subtitle: Ocarina of Time for iPhone & Vision Pro
localizedDescription: The Ship of Harkinian port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, running natively on Metal — the full quest with saves, the enhancements menu, texture-pack support, and on Apple Vision Pro a stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Ocarina of Time ROM and the app extracts it on device.
